pairs.reason: Forceful vomiting combined with severe thoracoabdominal pain and alcohol exposure gives esophageal rupture greater relative support initially. Removing that key precipitating event leaves acute chest pain, nausea and dyspnea, making possible acute coronary syndrome the more defensible of the two remaining candidates. This is a relative evidence shift, not an assertion that vomiting is absent.

The original joint, cutaneous and serosal constellation favors lupus. A new sustained ischemic-pattern chest-pain episode makes possible acute coronary syndrome the stronger immediate candidate, despite retained lupus features. All introduced descriptors characterize one new pain episode, yielding a usable within-pair preference direction.

A histamine-associated food exposure with an allergy-like skin and respiratory reaction favors scombroid initially. The new explicit allergy to the consumed food gives a specific antigen-trigger relationship and reasonably reverses relative support toward anaphylaxis while the reaction remains otherwise fixed.

An exertional syndrome relieved by rest supports stable angina initially. Newly progressive pain triggered by substantially less effort is the decisive change toward unstable angina within this fixed differential; the cardiovascular context stays constant.

The original combination of joint symptoms and a facial inflammatory eruption supports SLE relative to infarction. A new abrupt central chest-pressure episode with dyspnea shifts the acute presentation toward possible coronary ischemia in the retained risk context. Its onset and pressure quality describe one added event.

Exertional pain relieved by rest supports stable angina initially. Newly worsening symptoms occurring with progressively less effort are a decisive course change toward unstable angina with the same cardiovascular context.

Joint symptoms, facial rash and prior serositis support SLE initially. A newly described crushing central pain radiating to the arm gives a specific acute ischemic symptom pattern and reasonably reverses relative support toward possible infarction. Its intrinsic descriptors form one added event.
